title: Kissed Crumbly Kenyan Amaretti Cookies
description: A charred and crumbly cookie featuring amaretti, these Kenyan treats are perfect for midnight cravings, with a brine-dry and shojin-friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to cream together butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs one at a time, followed by vanilla extract.
Gradually mix in the flour mixture until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Scoop tablespoon-sized balls of dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until lightly charred on the bottom.
Remove from the oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes.
Transfer cookies to a wire rack to cool completely.
Dip the tops of the cooled cookies in the brine solution to achieve a dry, crumbly texture.
